name: tracker-notification-storage
goal: Prove additive startup on pinned 4a6be709 SQLite, unchanged historical delivery state, matching IDs and retry times, exact request replay after a failed acknowledgement, and same-database legacy rollback.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Pinned 4a6be709 store.js, notifier.js and webhook.js establish table schemas, webhook_seq and cos metadata, callback keys and batch ID hashes. Baseline runtime requires an external queue and has no durable SQLite implementation.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing notification cases use injected queues. A new native SQLite method/state matrix covers existing and missing schemas, pause and retry migration, uncertain send, restart, and legacy readback.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed 0ae42e7f63. Four SQLite cases identified the absent queue or the missing incompatible-schema check. The existing attention case also reproduced a third send while paused after an uncertain outcome.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Native runtime uses the existing six tables and legacy metadata, an atomic outstanding-attempt slot, and a file-based worker lock. Recovery preserves the exact request and honors a CoS pause.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The frozen SQLite and pause fixtures pass (7/7) at 62699034ec. Synthetic receipt replay preserves the request bytes and the receiver retains one receipt.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
